0.2.0.en: First release that can serve a panel: 0.1.0 failed at startup and restarted in a loop on any installation with ordinary detected devices. New tile types: climate, cover, media player, weather, number, select and date/time. History for sensor, binary sensor, number, select and date/time popups and graph tiles, from a history, SQL or InfluxDB instance. Energy tiles from cumulative energy meters (Energy tab). Opt-in device selection: nothing is published until Refresh detected devices and Save on the Devices tab. Manual entities, a Climate modes table and a per-row MQTT payload preview. The broker password is stored encrypted: after upgrading, start the adapter once before opening its settings, so it can migrate the stored password. Camera tiles are not supported. Not yet run on a physical panel.

0.1.0.en: Initial release: sensor, binary sensor, switch, light and scene tiles, panel control, local Hardware I/O and pairing.
